Following today's "special event," Apple has updated its official design resources website to include new bezel materials for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel materials now available

For designers, Apple's design resources website should be no stranger — it offers various hardware and software materials for use in their own work.

These materials are available in Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG file formats, covering Apple's major platforms, products, and technologies, including fonts, SF Symbols, the Icon Composer app, as well as logos and badges for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple immediately updated its design resources website to provide Photoshop and PNG materials for these two new devices.

The materials include both folded and unfolded states of the iPhone Duo, offered in two colour options; as for the iPhone 18 Pro model, it features a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the new bezel materials and other existing resources on Apple's design resources website, please click here.
